description: A CSS module defining styles for various button components, including variants for primary, secondary, success, and ghost buttons, as well as size variations and loading indicators.

classes.name: button
classes.description: Base style for buttons with rounded corners, flex display, and customizable appearance.

classes.name: full-width
classes.description: Style for buttons to take up full width with flex display.

classes.name: size-sm
classes.description: Style for small-sized buttons with specific padding and font size.

classes.name: size-md
classes.description: Style for medium-sized buttons with specific padding and font size.

classes.name: size-lg
classes.description: Style for large-sized buttons with specific padding and font size.

classes.name: variant-primary
classes.description: Style for primary variant buttons with background and text color customization.

classes.name: variant-secondary
classes.description: Style for secondary variant buttons with background and text color customization.

classes.name: variant-success
classes.description: Style for success variant buttons with background and text color customization.

classes.name: variant-ghost
classes.description: Style for ghost variant buttons with transparent background and primary border.

classes.name: disabled
classes.description: Style for disabled buttons to indicate non-interactivity.

classes.name: loading
classes.description: Style for buttons showing loading state with no pointer events.

classes.name: spinner
classes.description: Style for loading spinner included in buttons.

classes.name: invisible
classes.description: Style for making elements invisible without affecting layout.

classes.name: variant-outline
classes.description: Style for outline variant buttons with transparent background and primary border.

classes.name: button-icon
classes.description: Style for buttons that include icons with flex alignment.

classes.name: icon-left
classes.description: Styles for icons placed to the left of button text.

classes.name: icon-right
classes.description: Styles for icons placed to the right of button text.
